text: So Yahuud en e Nasaara en e heeferɓe woɓɓe ngoonɗinii wano goonɗinal mon ngal, tawa ɓe peewii e laawol pooccingol ngol Alla welaa, so ɓe caliima goonɗinde, ɓe penni Annabaaɓe fof wolla yoga e maɓɓe, ndeen ɓe ngoni ko e luutondiral e gañondiral, taa mettin - Aan Annabi - maa Alla danndu ma tooñe maɓɓe, O haɗan maa bone maɓɓe, O walle, Kanko woni nanoowo haalaaji mume en, gannduɗo enniyaaji e golle mum en.
